mappingMethod: Explicit field/limit contracts, prior-work corpus searches and current receipts. A scalar mapping covers its comparison quantity, not native execution of an announced patch fix. Generic gadget/vehicle fixes stay unmapped; their exact semantics are owned by the concurrent session. Name matches provide context only.
inference: Coverage is bounded by the inspected current project receipts/docs/site snapshot. It is not an assertion that no undiscovered source exists.
The one stale display conflict is description versus curve; the numerical curve matches.
Eight new source questions lack a question-specific named route/control pair and were not launched. No unnamed scans or source-zero claims.
unresolved: Counts are source item mentions, including dated preview/historical context. They are not unique mechanics or native fixes verified.
Unmapped means no specific inspected field/finding/parked limit covers the item. A name or general profile is not an identity join.
Generic gadget/vehicle fixes remain unmapped and go to existing candidate docs. Do not duplicate L640-L679 semantics work.
